description: Team profile: country, founded, venue, leagues, logo link; summary (soccer, NBA, NHL, MLB, NFL teams): ready paragraphs from our data (table place and gaps, record, form, home and away, squad leaders, next opponent; English, no lang; not with squad, injuries or season_stats of a US team; summary_as_of; absent when not fresh); rating: its Elo-style rating (rank of of in its league, matches_rated, rated_from, the last 10 changes); next: its next 5 matches in every competition (more: get_matches with team_id; fixture congestion: get_team_briefing). Soccer also coach: the current head coach from Wikidata with appointment date and won/drawn/lost since (record_complete false: our matches start later, at record_from, so say the record covers only that; cite the attribution), and squad_value_eur: the current squad's summed market value over players_with_value of squad_players. Options: squad (the players); soccer: coach (adds previous_coach and previous_club), facts (runs, first since, milestones; Insights feature), season_stats (the current season per league: home/away records, goals, clean sheets, biggest win and defeat, xG over matches_with_xg, home attendance over matches_with_attendance, the team's rank per metric), transfers (the latest 20), honours (titles and runners-up with sources), injuries (players out for coming matches: type, expected_return null = not known, never guess one; matches_missed a lower bound when matches_missed_complete is false). For an MLB, NBA, WNBA, NHL or NFL team, injuries returns its current injury report and season_stats its season statistics instead of the profile.

coach.description: soccer: also return coach: the head coach with appointment date, record since, previous coach and previous club

facts.description: soccer: also return facts: current runs, runs its last match ended, first since, record, table, next match stakes, player milestones (needs the insights feature)

honours.description: soccer: also return honours: titles and runners-up per competition, each with its source (provider: the profile's trophy list, every competition, can lag the latest season; wikipedia: league tables of the last 10 seasons) and disagreements, seasons the sources tell apart: report both, never pick one silently

injuries.description: return the team's injury report instead (MLB, NBA, WNBA, NHL, NFL); soccer: added as injuries (players out for its coming matches with type, expected_return, matches_missed); needs the injuries feature

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

season_stats.description: return the team's current season statistics instead (MLB, NBA, WNBA, NHL, NFL); soccer: added as season_stats (per league, computed from our matches)

team_id.description: team code (or number) from find_teams or a match

transfers.description: soccer: also return the team's latest 20 transfers in and out (more: get_transfers)

name: get_team
